checklist.ref: studio project 725908 (dressable-g9) step 16 pass_criteria (5) + decision 1994543 (hair/face must not regress)

items.text: The woman wears an A-line skirt that flares from the waist and ends around knee length
Over it she wears a long-sleeved zip-up jacket with a visible centre-front zip
No bare skin pokes through the skirt or the jacket in any panel (bare feet, hands, legs below the hem, neck and face are expected and do not count)
No visible holes, tears, spikes or shredded geometry in either garment in any panel
In the walking, sitting, arms-raised and twisting panels the garments move with the body and stay on it
The character has a full head of long copper/auburn hair and an intact face with eyes (not bald, not featureless)
